records.note: Hyundai's Korea-market 8th-generation AVANTE release dated 2026-08-05 identifies the 2.0 gasoline powertrain and 149 PS. Run queue snapshot year resolves to 2026 and Encar detail identifies AVANTE 2.0, gasoline, 1,999 cc, production 2026-09; its separate category formYear field says 2027. This year-field discrepancy is recorded explicitly; the draft key uses the run snapshot year (2026), not a claim that both fields agree. Preliminary manufacturer-spec evidence only, not TKS-approved.
